description:
List files in a workspace (yours, or any public one). Use prefix like 'drafts/' to list a folder. Each file
    carries its latest version, sha256 and saved_by (0.52.0), so a workspace can be checked in one call.

api_token.description: Your hashn API token, if you can't send it as the 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' header. Omit it when the header is set.
api_token.title: Api Token

prefix.description: Only files whose path starts with this, e.g. 'drafts/'. Empty lists everything.
prefix.title: Prefix

workspace_id.description: The workspace's id (a UUID), from create_workspace, list_workspaces or the store.
workspace_id.title: Workspace Id

name: list_files
